sources.entry: isGenAI - Checks images, links and text for recorded evidence of AI use: C2PA Content Credentials, AI labels and saved generation prompts, quoting each source. #free

summary.name: isGenAI
summary.one_liner: isGenAI (isgenai.com) is a free AI content detector that checks a public image, article or link and reports the recorded evidence of AI use, such as C2PA Content Credentials, AI disclosures and tool mentions.
use_cases: Check whether a public article discloses AI use
Verify C2PA Content Credentials on an image
Review a web page for AI tool mentions
Inspect a downloaded file for AI creation records
Check pasted text or code for AI use
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a checker that takes one exact public article or image URL and reads the page text for AI-use disclosures and tool mentions. It also inspects the main image for supported creation records such as signed C2PA records. Each finding is tied to the page or file that supplied it, and a "How we checked" view shows which sources produced each result and which checks completed. Separate tools are offered for text and code, image files, and downloaded files carrying AI records. The page states it checks only the submitted resource and does not crawl whole domains or bypass logins, paywalls or CAPTCHAs.
notable: Pins every finding to the specific page or file that produced it
Distinguishes disclosures and tool mentions from signed C2PA image records
Checks one submitted public URL rather than crawling a domain
Separate image, text/code and file checkers
caveats: Public links create public reports; private material should use the upload or pasted-text workflow
Copied or re-exported files may have lost their labels, so results can be incomplete
Does not crawl whole domains or get past logins, paywalls or CAPTCHAs
